data.name: Bartend
data.success_message: You served drinks to rowdy patrons and earned good tips!
data.failure_message: A bounty hunter started a fight - you lost money in the chaos.

data.name: Smuggle Spice
data.success_message: You successfully smuggled spice past the Imperial patrol!
data.failure_message: Imperial forces caught you - your cargo is confiscated.

data.name: Assemble Starship
data.success_message: You successfully assembled a starship component - quality work!
data.failure_message: A critical part failed during assembly - damage costs deducted.

data.name: Design Prototype
data.success_message: Your prototype design was approved for production!
data.failure_message: The prototype failed stress tests - materials wasted.

data.name: Extract Tibanna Gas
data.success_message: You safely extracted valuable tibanna gas!
data.failure_message: A gas leak caused an explosion - medical bills deducted.

data.name: Negotiate Contract
data.success_message: You secured a lucrative contract for Cloud City!
data.failure_message: The negotiations fell through - wasted time.

data.name: Restore Holocron
data.success_message: You restored an ancient Jedi holocron - the Archives are grateful!
data.failure_message: You accidentally corrupted the holocron data.

data.name: Research Force Lore
data.success_message: You discovered ancient Force techniques!
data.failure_message: The texts were encrypted beyond your ability to decipher.

data.name: Install Superlaser
data.success_message: You made progress installing the superlaser array!
data.failure_message: You caused a critical delay - Imperial penalties applied.

data.name: Steal Schematics
data.success_message: You escaped with the Death Star schematics!
data.failure_message: You were captured and interrogated - all assets seized.

data.name: Fortify Defenses
data.success_message: You reinforced the base's defenses against Imperial attack!
data.failure_message: An avalanche destroyed your work - materials lost.

data.name: Scout Imperial Movements
data.success_message: Your intelligence helped the Alliance prepare!
data.failure_message: Your scouting party was ambushed by snowtroopers.

data.name: Assemble Droid
data.success_message: A new B1 battle droid rolls off the assembly line!
data.failure_message: The droid's programming corrupted - scrap.

data.name: Design New Droid
data.success_message: Your new droid design enters mass production!
data.failure_message: The prototype malfunctioned catastrophically.

data.name: Forge Beskar
data.success_message: You successfully forged pure beskar armor!
data.failure_message: The beskar was contaminated - worthless.

data.name: Hunt Bounty
data.success_message: You captured the bounty - the Guild pays well!
data.failure_message: Your target escaped after a brutal gunfight.

data.name: Survey Lava Fields
data.success_message: Your geological probes detected a rich durasteel ore vein beneath the lava crust!
data.failure_message: The volcanic heat destroyed your sensors before any ore was located.

data.name: Extract Durasteel Ore
data.success_message: Mining drills broke through the crust and hauled up a solid load of durasteel ore!
data.failure_message: A lava surge flooded the shaft — equipment damaged and extraction halted.

data.name: Scout Venom Pools
data.success_message: Hazmat scouts located a dense venom pool bubbling with harvestable toxins!
data.failure_message: Toxic fumes drove the scouts back before any pool was mapped.

data.name: Harvest Quesh Venom
data.success_message: Sealed collection units pumped a full vat of Quesh venom — handle with extreme care.
data.failure_message: Suit breach during collection — hazmat decontamination costs applied.

data.name: Survey Crystal Veins
data.success_message: Deep resonance scans revealed a Kyber crystal cluster buried in Mygeeto's ice walls!
data.failure_message: The blizzard conditions forced the survey team back without any readings.

data.name: Extract Kyber Crystals
data.success_message: Precision drills extracted a pristine Kyber crystal from the glacial rock — beautiful.
data.failure_message: The crystal shattered under improper extraction pressure — loss deducted.

data.name: Smelt Durasteel Alloy
data.success_message: Raw ore fed into the furnace emerges as gleaming durasteel alloy — the Empire is pleased!
data.failure_message: Furnace overload cracked the mold — batch ruined and cleanup costs deducted.

data.name: Transport Alloy Shipment
data.success_message: Alloy shipment loaded and delivered to the receiving depot without incident!
data.failure_message: No alloy shipments are ready for transport at this time.

data.name: Synthesise Sith Poison
data.success_message: The alchemical reaction completes — a vial of potent Sith poison is bottled and sealed.
data.failure_message: The reaction went unstable. Lab decontamination costs deducted.

data.name: Courier Classified Toxin
data.success_message: Classified toxin delivered to the designated secure facility under Sith seal.
data.failure_message: No toxins are ready for courier at this time.

data.name: Cut Kyber Crystal
data.success_message: The crystal catches the light perfectly — a refined Kyber gem ready for installation.
data.failure_message: Crystal resonance destabilised the cutting chamber — batch lost.

data.name: Ship Crystal Consignment
data.success_message: Crystal consignment delivered to the syndicate's receiving station.
data.failure_message: No crystal consignments are ready for shipping at this time.

data.name: Stock the Black Market
data.success_message: Processed goods moved from back-room storage onto the black market shelves — business is booming!
data.failure_message: Shelves already stocked or no goods available to move.

data.name: Receive Supply Run
data.success_message: Supply crates offloaded and catalogued at the syndicate warehouse.
data.failure_message: No deliveries pending at this time.

data.name: Broker Contraband Deal
data.success_message: You brokered a profitable deal between Hutt buyers and offworld suppliers!
data.failure_message: The deal fell through — a rival syndicate undercut you.

data.name: Run Spice Shipment
data.success_message: The spice shipment cleared customs — the Hutts reward your discretion handsomely.
data.failure_message: Imperial customs seized the shipment — heavy fines levied.
